_about: Company variables for the world layer. kind: fixed (does not change), decision (changed only by a decision), weekly (changes every week). source: the dossier sentence word for word (11-aisle.md), or 'ours: <reason>'.

budget_total.source: Decision menu (budget: $2.5 million for both decisions)

action_cost.source: | Discount paid by Aisle, one category, one week you choose | 5%: $0.6M · 10%: $1.2M | ... | Ads and influencer content | $0.15M · $0.4M | (the ten menu rows)

buyers_month.source: 6.5 million visitors and 1.2 million buyers a month; average order $60.

avg_order.source: 6.5 million visitors and 1.2 million buyers a month; average order $60.

plan_bf_cm.source: Black Friday week and Cyber Monday are planned at $48 million.

category_mix.source: 4,500 independent sellers sell fashion (45% of sales), home (30%) and electronics (25%).

holiday_lift.source: ours: Census MRTS NAICS 4541, not adjusted, 2023-2025 (dis-veri/census_mrts_4541_mevsim.csv): December/October 1.247 over November/October 1.106 = 1.128, so December weeks are 12.8% above a November week. January: no data in the file, kept at 1.0.

plan_split.source: ours: the dossier gives only the $48M sum for Black Friday week and Cyber Monday; split evenly between weeks 4 and 5.

carrier_share.source: Carriers: Rapid Parcel carries 45% of orders, Meridian 35%, Dash 20%.

carrier_headroom.source: ours: a carrier ships up to 1.3 times a normal week; ShipMatrix Cyber Week 2025: +30% volume over pre-peak with 97-99% delivered within a day of promise (dis-veri/KAYNAKLAR.md).

strike_state.source: From week 5 (Tuesday, December 1): a possible strike at Rapid Parcel. Changes only through an announcement ({"set": {"strike_state": "on"}}) or --strike on|off.

strike_capacity.source: ours: 'Rapid Parcel says it would keep delivering with managers and temporary drivers, more slowly.' How slow is unknown; half its capacity. Anchor: Royal Mail 2022-23 strikes, on time 73.7% against a 93% target (dis-veri/KAYNAKLAR.md).

strike_extra_days.source: ours: slower handling by managers and temporary drivers adds 2 days to Rapid Parcel's mid estimate while the strike is on.

seller_shift.source: ours: while Rapid Parcel runs late, sellers move 10% of their Rapid Parcel parcels to Meridian and Dash per day of delay, up to 60%, within those carriers' 30% headroom. Anchor: in the 2024 Canada Post strike small firms moved parcels to private couriers until those reached capacity (CFIB, 2024). The locked week-5 message also tells sellers they can move parcels.

rapid_days_max.source: ours: a Rapid Parcel parcel takes at most about two weeks; what would wait longer is cancelled or re-shipped with another carrier and leaves the backlog. Not in the dossier; the team's cap (24 Oct).

spare_capacity.source: Extra capacity from Meridian and Dash for 2 weeks | +20%: $0.4M · +40%: $0.8M. ours: the extra capacity takes Rapid Parcel's backlog first.

backlog.source: ours: parcels Rapid Parcel cannot carry in a week wait for the next week; each full week of backlog adds 7 days to its delivery estimate.

checkout_promise.source: The delivery estimate at checkout says "2–4 days".

payout_freq.source: Faster seller payouts (weekly → twice a week) for 6 weeks

complaint_sla.source: Complaints are answered within 48 hours; claims that a product is fake go to the seller first. Extra support staff for 4 weeks (+100): ours, answers within 24h.

return_policy.value: orders from November 1 can be returned until January 31
return_policy.source: Holiday returns: orders from November 1 can be returned until January 31.

discount.source: Discount paid by Aisle, one category, one week you choose | 5%: $0.6M · 10%: $1.2M

return_shipping.source: ours: the dossier does not say return shipping is free, and the menu sells 'Free return shipping for 4 weeks'.

fake_claims.source: claims that a product is fake go to the seller first. Authenticity guarantee for 8 weeks: double refund if a product is proven fake

seller_audit.source: Seller check: audit the top 500 sellers in risky categories, suspend those that fail

ads.source: Ads and influencer content | $0.15M · $0.4M. ours: runs 2 weeks (the dossier gives no length).

channels.source: Messages: email, push, in-app banners and social media posts are free.

message_max_chars.source: the message the company sends: the exact words, up to 600 characters, and the channels (02-challenge.md)

actions_per_decision.source: one to three actions from your dossier's decision menu, each at one of the listed levels (02-challenge.md)

decisions_max.source: You make exactly two decisions for your client, in any weeks you choose. (02-challenge.md)

value.discount: Discount paid by Aisle, one category, one week you choose
value.extra_capacity: Extra capacity from Meridian and Dash for 2 weeks
value.seller_check: Seller check: audit the top 500 sellers in risky categories, suspend those that fail
value.authenticity_guarantee: Authenticity guarantee for 8 weeks: double refund if a product is proven fake
value.faster_payouts: Faster seller payouts (weekly → twice a week) for 6 weeks

menu_rows.source: Decision menu, the Action column word for word: a decision may name an action by this text or by its key.
